newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee slides with NY, cocoa at lows in PM.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee slides with NY, cocoa at lows in PM.

text.p: COFFEE - Follows NY lower after earlier strength, eyes on July arabicas expiry. Sept robustas down $25 at $1,580 by 1404 GMT.
COCOA - Fills chart gap, Sept slumbers at four-month lows. Down 36 stg at 979 just off session trough.
SUGAR - October dominates modest volume but slips off highs with mundane NY performance. Up $1.20 at $324.50.
